title: kate-session: collect the project files
summary: Project::files returns every file of every source as a path relative to base_dir, after the exclude patterns are applied, sorted, with duplicates removed. A Git source uses git_files, a Directory source uses directory_files, and a List source uses its paths as they are.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. The crate is pure Rust and builds anywhere. The backlog marks this title LOCAL so the Mac lane keeps the panes and their models together.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Remove the dead_code attributes from walk.rs, git.rs, and exclude.rs items; Project::files now calls them. For each source, get the paths from git_files, directory_files, or the list, join them onto the source directory, and strip base_dir with Path::strip_prefix; a path outside base_dir is kept as given. Compile the excludes once; a relative path whose forward-slash string is excluded is dropped. Sort and dedup the result. The test files_joins_sources_and_applies_excludes builds a tempdir with src/a.rs, src/b.rs, and target/c.rs, a Project with one Directory source for . recursive true and exclude_patterns ["^target/"], and asserts files is [src/a.rs, src/b.rs]. A second Project with a List source [src/b.rs, src/b.rs] asserts one entry. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: project::tests::files_joins_sources_and_applies_excludes
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because Project::files does not exist. After the change the directory walk is filtered by the exclude pattern and a list source is deduplicated.
